integrity: All claims proved by a direct finite-powerset argument and an explicit polynomial reduction. Exhaustive small tests are supplementary and are not represented as infinite proof. No independent audit or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The expressivity result fixes an entire finite team domain; strict semantics can fail locality under domain projection. NP-completeness is combined complexity, not fixed-formula/data complexity, and does not unconditionally separate P from NP. Similar earlier theorems under alternative strict-split terminology remain a priority risk.
title: Strict splitting preserves fixed-domain expressivity but makes nonemptiness-team model checking NP-complete
